title: Family Gathering Outside Summer Cabin, 1930s B&W Snapshot Photo
description: An informal snapshot capturing a multigenerational group of family members and friends congregated in front of a wood-sided summer cabin or bungalow. The figures are dressed in casual late-1920s to early-1930s attire, featuring summer sun hats, cloche-style headwear, floral house dresses, and high-waisted trousers on a young woman who gazes directly into the lens. The doorway overhead is flanked by rustic hanging lantern lamps, suggesting a vacation retreat or rustic camp setting during the interwar era.
